newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN IN PROFIT-TAKING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES SEEN DOWN IN PROFIT-TAKING.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to fall in profit-taking after Monday's third straight 34-month high which was followed by stronger selling after price-fixing.

But analysts said the buying frenzy that has pushed the market up 32 percent since mid-December could prove strong enough to extend the record, as some large-cap stocks showed stronger post-price-fixing buying on Monday.
These included Bank Slaski , Zywiec and Stomil Olsztyn .
